output.question: What acquisitions has IBM made?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, IBM’s recent acquisitions include Logiq Consulting (announced September 24, 2026), HRL Laboratories (completed August 26, 2026), and Confluent (completed March 17, 2026). IBM also completed its acquisition of HashiCorp on February 27, 2025. Earlier acquisitions include the StreamSets and webMethods businesses from Software AG, completed July 1, 2024, and Apptio, completed August 10, 2023. A major historical acquisition was Red Hat, completed July 9, 2019, for approximately $34 billion in equity value as reported at closing. This is a selected list, not IBM’s complete acquisition history.

key_facts.fact: IBM announced the acquisition of UK cybersecurity consultancy Logiq Consulting on September 24, 2026.
IBM completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories on August 26, 2026.
IBM completed its acquisition of Confluent on March 17, 2026.
IBM completed its acquisition of HashiCorp on February 27, 2025.
IBM completed its acquisition of StreamSets and webMethods from Software AG on July 1, 2024.
IBM completed its acquisition of Apptio on August 10, 2023.
IBM completed its acquisition of Red Hat on July 9, 2019; approximately $34 billion was the total equity value reported at closing.

IBM Closes Landmark Acquisition of Red Hat for $34 Billion; Defines Open, Hybrid Cloud Future

caveats: The list highlights selected recent and significant completed acquisitions; it is not exhaustive.
September 24, 2026 is the announcement date for Logiq Consulting; the release does not separately specify a closing date.
StreamSets and webMethods were acquired businesses, not an acquisition of Software AG itself.
The Red Hat release is dated July 10, 2019 on IBM’s Canadian newsroom, while its text dates the closing announcement July 9, 2019.
